rationale: Field inspection role checking roads, footpaths, drainage and civil reinstatement works against drawings and standards, recording defects and keeping inspection records, which matches Marc's 2019 to 2020 site inspections, safety and quality checks, drawing reviews and site reports.

Entry is a qualification in civil engineering or civil construction and/or experience; Marc holds a BSCE (2019) and an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2026) with road, pavement and stormwater design, and a White Card.
Aberfeldie depot is in Melbourne's inner north west, a realistic commute from Melton; no citizenship, PR or minimum years gate, and the 12 month term ends before his work rights do.
caution: Band 5 officer role, not a graduate post: other applicants may have Australian council inspection experience. It is part time, three days a week. Marc has not used a council asset management system or mobile inspection app, and the Road Management Plan would be new. A written Key Selection Criteria response is required or the application may not be considered.
